from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from evals.run import fingerprints, save, trial_status, validate_case
from evals.metrics import aggregate, trace_metrics
from evals.sandbox import ROOT, Case, ProcessResult, checked, copy_project, grade, installed_workspace

source = ROOT / '.eval-results/sonnet-release'
output = ROOT / '.eval-results/sonnet-regraded'
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
original = json.loads((source / 'summary.json').read_text())
assert original['complete'] and original['valid']
cases = [ROOT / 'evals/cases' / name for name in original['cases']]
initial = fingerprints(cases)
report = {
    'kind': 'frozen_artifact_regrade', 'schema_version': 1,
    'original_summary_sha256': hashlib.sha256((source / 'summary.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'original_revision': original['revision'],
    'grader_revision': checked(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT),
    'dirty': bool(checked(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=ROOT)),
    'fingerprints': initial, 'started_at': time.time(), 'complete': False,
    'new_model_calls': 0, 'results': [], 'calibration': {},
}
save(output / 'regrade.json', report)
for case in cases:
    image = original['images'][case.name]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rio-regrade-') as directory:
        base = Path(directory) / 'base'
        base.mkdir()
        environment = installed_workspace(image, base)
        assert environment == original['task_environments'][case.name]
        calibration = validate_case(case, base, image, 300)
        assert calibration['valid'], case.name
        save(output / (case.name + '-validation.json'), calibration)
        report['calibration'][case.name] = {
            'valid': calibration['valid'],
            'probes': {name: {'status': value['status'], 'tests': value['tests']} for name, value in calibration['probes'].items()},
        }
        for row in [row for row in original['results'] if row['case'] == case.name]:
            submitted = source / case.name / str(row['trial'])
            patch = submitted / 'agent.diff'
            candidate = Path(directory) / str(row['trial'])
            copy_project(base, candidate)
            checked(['git', 'init', '-q', str(candidate)])
            if patch.read_text().strip():
                checked(['git', 'apply', str(patch)], cwd=candidate)
            result = grade(case, base, candidate, image, timeout=300)
            metrics = trace_metrics((submitted / 'agent.jsonl').read_text())
            process = ProcessResult(returncode=row['agent_exit'], seconds=row['seconds'], timed_out=row['status'] == 'agent_timeout')
            status = trial_status(Case.load(case), process, metrics, result)
            item = {**row, 'original_status': row['status'], 'status': status, 'passed': status == 'passed',
                    'grader_status': result.status, 'regrading_seconds': result.process.seconds,
                    'patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                    'regraded_tests': result.tests, 'regrading_detail': result.detail}
            report['results'].append(item)
            save(output / (case.name + '-' + str(row['trial']) + '-grade.json'), result.model_dump())
            save(output / 'regrade.json', report)
            print(case.name, row['trial'], row['status'], '->', status, flush=True)
report.update(complete=True, finished_at=time.time(), inputs_unchanged=initial == fingerprints(cases),
              total=len(report['results']), passed=sum(row['passed'] for row in report['results']),
              per_case=aggregate(report['results']))
assert report['total'] == 60 and report['inputs_unchanged']
save(output / 'regrade.json', report)
print(str(report['passed']) + '/60 regraded; no new model calls')
